sources.title: Cloven Hoof Fuzz Grinder — EarthQuaker Devices
sources.excerpt:
Cloven Hoof Fuzz Grinder — EarthQuaker Devices Contact Us Use the form on the right to contact us. You can edit the text in this area, and change where the contact form on the right submits to, by entering edit mode using the modes on the bottom right.  Form Block This form needs a storage option. Double-click here to edit this form, and tell us where to save form submissions in the Storage tab. Learn more 350 West Bowery Street Akron, OH, 44307 United States +1 330 252-9220 orders@earthquakerdevices.com Official website for EarthQuaker Devices . We build guitar effects by hand in the quaint landlocked city of Akron, Ohio. Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Menu EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch Cloven Hoof Fuzz Grinder THIS DEVICE IS NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION Cloven Hoof® Fuzz Grinder The Cloven Hoof is the Hoof’s evil twin. It looks a lot like the Hoof, only more, um . . . Cloven. We kept the tightness and clarity you loved about the Hoof, along with the wide range of fuzz sounds, and threw the rest away. NOS Germanium transistors? Nope! In their place, we installed a set of four specially selected Silicon transistors for cleaner cleans, higher gain, improved temperature stability, and a grittier, grindier, nastier fuzz tone with over 4x the gain of the original Hoof. We also replaced key resistors with NOS Carbon Comp components to sprinkle a little bit of vintage flavor into the Cloven Hoof’s searing fuzz fury. It’s like they always say, “In with the old, out with the new.” The Tone and Shift controls remain intact, only now they’re re-voiced for a smoother sweep, and more precise control over the Cloven Hoof’s beefy low-end. Speaking of low-end, have you heard this thing on bass? Wow. Try the Cloven Hoof on a bass guitar. Seriously. Trust us. You can still cut or boost the mids, and there’s still a metric ton of output on tap, just do us a favor, and for the love of all that’s Cloven, play this pedal with a bass guitar. View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize Controls     1. Shift: This adjusts the mid content. Clockwise for scooped mids, counterclockwise for boosted. 2. Tone: Bass to the left. Treble to the right 3. Level: Use this control to make the Cloven Hoof louder or quieter. 4. Fuzz: Clockwise for heavy, counterclockwise for light. Audio Samples GUITAR SAMPLES DopeSleeper Gibson Les Paul Neck Rock Gibson Les Paul Sweeping Tone & Shift Gibson Les Paul Switchblade Sweep Gibson Les Paul Sweeping Drop D's Fender Telecaster   BASS SAMPLES A Miserable Thirst Music Man Bass Filthy Fists of Doom Music Man Bass Hell Hole Music Man Bass   View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize Tech Specs Dimensions: 4.75 x 2.50 x 2.25 in. (121 x 64 x 57 mm) with knobs Current Draw: 14 mA Input Impedance: 150 kΩ Output Impedance: <10 kΩ Switching This device is true bypass and uses electronic relay-based switching. Audio will not pass without power. Power This device can be powered by a 9v battery or a standard 9-volt DC power supply with a 2.1mm negative center barrel. We always recommend pedal-specific, transformer-isolated wall-wart power supplies or multiple isolated-output supplies. Pedals will make extra noise if there is ripple or unclean power. Switching-type power supplies, daisy chains and non-pedal specific power supplies do not filter dirty power as well and let through unwanted noise. DO NOT RUN AT HIGHER VOLTAGES! The **EarthQuaker Devices Cloven Hoof** is a **Fuzz Grinder** derived from the Hoof concept. EarthQuaker Devices describes the design as keeping the tightness and clarity associated with the Hoof while replacing its earlier architecture with **four specially selected silicon transistors** for higher gain, improved temperature stability, and a grittier fuzz voice. [1]

The archive keeps **Fuzz** as the primary taxonomy.

The reviewed evidence references **V2**. No complete factory revision chronology was established, so V2 is preserved as an observed version reference rather than expanded into a complete sequence.

The manufacturer explicitly identifies **four specially selected silicon transistors** as part of the Cloven Hoof design. [1]

The archive does not infer exact transistor part numbers or a complete production BOM from that statement.

The archive also contains a record named **Cloven Hoof - Fuzz Grinder**. Because EarthQuaker Devices itself uses “Cloven Hoof Fuzz Grinder” as the product name, the second record is likely an expanded naming alias rather than a separate pedal. [1]
